dog.description_text:
Vito is a handsome boy with a sweet face and a heart that deserves to know what it feels like to be loved.

He was found wandering the streets of New York, searching for food and trying to survive. He had been eating from garbage cans and was terribly thin, nothing but skin and bones. It is heartbreaking to think about what this beautiful boy must have endured just to get through each day.

But Vito’s story does not have to end with what he went through.

Now, we want to help him leave that difficult chapter behind and discover the life he should have had all along. A life with a safe place to sleep, regular meals, loving people, and a family who will never let him feel forgotten again.

Vito is such a beautiful, sweet boy, and we would love nothing more than to see him surrounded by the love and care he deserves. After everything he has been through, he deserves a home where he can finally relax, feel secure, and simply enjoy being a dog.

Please consider opening your heart and home to Vito. This handsome boy has already been through so much, and he deserves a future filled with love, comfort, and happiness.

Please remember that adoption bios are only a snapshot of each animal. They are meant to give you a glimpse into their personality and story, but there is so much more to learn. Please reach out to our Adoption Team for additional information about Vito and to learn if he may be the right fit for your home.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in fostering or adopting? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
